goal: A SQLite database-is-locked error past busy-timeout is retried with bounded backoff and the operation's real result is returned; exhausting the budget raises a TRANSIENT-classified failure.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_sqlite.py -- busy_timeout is set (line ~175); wrap store operations so a locked-past-timeout OperationalError retries with bounded backoff
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_store_sqlite.py -- add locked_retry and locked_classified tests; hold a write lock on the same DB file from a competing connection to force the lock
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_store_contract.py -- the shared store contract suite must stay green
constraints: Reuse the TRANSIENT classification and bounded-backoff helper from transient-classifier-backoff; classify the locked-past-budget case TRANSIENT
locked_retry: a lock held shorter than the total transient budget must let the competing call return its REAL expected value with no OperationalError propagated -- not a fabricated/empty success
locked_classified: a lock held longer than the budget must raise a TRANSIENT-classified failure
Widening busy_timeout alone is insufficient -- the fix is retry-with-backoff so it also covers dropped connections; keep busy_timeout as-is or document any change
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under tests/ except adding the two named tests; do not weaken the store-contract assertions
Do not blanket-classify every store error TRANSIENT -- schema mismatch must remain PERMANENT (graded by the matrix holdout)
edge_cases: Returning an empty/fabricated value after catching the lock instead of completing the operation must fail locked_retry (assert on the operation's actual result)
A schema-mismatch error reaching this retry path must NOT be retried as TRANSIENT
